The '''Thassalia system''' was located in the [[Albanin sector/Legends|Albanin sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the title of [[Blood Prince of Thassalia]].<ref name="SoL">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Thassalia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square U-12.<ref name="TEA" />
